The '''''IR-3F''-class light frigate''', commonly referred to as the '''IR-3F patrol craft''' or '''IR-3F''', was a light [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] designed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use as a system patrol and customs ship.

==Characteristics==
The IR-3F was 110 meters long. It had a high power output and fast sublight engines for a ship of its size, and could achieve atmospheric flight at 1,000 kilometers per hour; however, it was not equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref><ref name="TABSB" /> It was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], and armed with four [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannon turrets, though some models were equipped with four fire-linked heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] instead.<ref name="TABSB" /><ref name="GATORW" />

The ship had a crew of 11 (including 8 gunners), though it could be staffed by a single individual in some circumstances. It carried ten troops, three months' worth of [[Foodstuff/Legends|consumables]], and had space for 180 metric tons of cargo.<ref name="TABSB" /> The small crew was often inadequately rotated, resulting in a tendency for them to wear down quickly.<ref name="P&P" />

Patrol ship tactics generally led to these ships operating within an hour's distance of their base of operations, and maintaining continuous comlink contact with it.<ref name="FOP" /> When engaging a target, they employed their high speed and brute force to disable or destroy it before it could escape into hyperspace.<ref name="TABSB" />

==History==
The IR-3F was the predecessor of the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]].<ref name="P&P" /> However, the craft still saw some use with single-system governments, including [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] within the [[Ringali Shell]].<ref name="P&P" /><ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> It also saw limited use in the Imperial services, particularly in systems with large support vessel populations or ongoing blockades.<ref name="P&P" />

IR-3Fs formed the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Digit Squadron]] at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. Five of them fought against the [[Ssi-ruu]]k at the [[Battle of Bakura]]; three of those ships survived, becoming the property of the Bakuran government when that world became independent.<ref name="TABSB" /> They continued serving under the Bakuran government for decades afterward.<ref name="GATORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ir-3f.jpg|thumb|left|A ship depicted in ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'' sometimes believed to be IR-3F]]
The IR-3F was illustrated in ''The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook'' as looking much like the IPV-1, in line with its description. An image from ''Pirates & Priateers'' neighboring its description in that sourcebook is sometimes associaterd with it; however there is no canonical evidence for that, and the unsigned image is also resembling a [[Conqueror Assault Ship]] that is described next to it.
